cards.claim: Armin Kavehei attended Universidad del Norte.
cards.quote: As a student at Universidad del Norte, he had been drawn to the university's esteemed neuroscience program, where he had devoured texts on cognitive psychology and neural networks like a starving man at a feast.

It was only natural that he would be drawn to Macquarie University, an institution renowned for its cutting-edge research facilities and esteemed faculty. The university's strong reputation in the fields of biomedical engineering and neuroscience made it the perfect haven for Armin's inquisitive mind. In 2011, Armin Kavehei officially enrolled in Macquarie University's Ph.D.
